channel.title: Kolaboro weekly market digest
channel.description: New off-plan projects, slipped dates, moved promises, page, register and satellite changes, by market. Counted by code from the public data.

item.title: Kolaboro weekly digest, week 45 2026 (to date)
item.description: Kolaboro data show 1016 projects tracked across 170 markets in week 45. New projects numbered 138, spread over 47 markets. 0 projects passed their promised date this week, while 17 projects had their promised date moved later. Text changed on 343 pages. Register lookups dated this week numbered 48, and 27 satellite flags are standing. These figures come from the public data files and their daily history.

item.title: Kolaboro weekly digest, week 44 2026
item.description: Kolaboro data for week 44 (26 October 2026 to 1 November 2026) cover 878 anonymous off-plan projects in 144 markets. 854 new project ids appeared in 144 markets. 0 projects became overdue or had a promise newly marked broken. Every figure is counted by code from the public data files and their daily history.
